items.description: The report states the drift as totalAssets > HALF_SLOPE * square(totalShares) but supplies no scaling constant or unit conversion that makes the asset-token quantity and the fixed-point-times-share-squared quantity commensurable; the numeric relation is recorded as a grounded Boolean rather than an invented unit bridge.
The report does not give the concrete deposit amount or the exact state walk that produces totalAssets > HALF_SLOPE * square(totalShares); the SLOPE=2e18 walk is illustrative only.
The report does not state whether the previewMint-routed deposit is permissionless or who may call previewMint.
